anomalies.description: Two individuals engage in intense physical combat in a tiled bathroom; one person lifts and throws the other toward a toilet, with clear mutual engagement and dynamic grappling.
After initial mutual combat, the attacker forces the victim headfirst into the toilet bowl and holds them there, indicating a shift to one-sided violent subjugation of a helpless victim.
A man in a leather jacket violently forces another shirtless man's head into a toilet bowl, holding him down and submerging his face; the victim appears helpless and distressed.
The shirtless man attempts to resist by raising his arm and pushing back against the attacker while his head is in the toilet, indicating mutual physical struggle during the assault.
